+"""Load images from inline data or the configured object store."""
+import base64
+from urllib.parse import unquote, unquote_to_bytes, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(source: str | None) -> bytes | None:
+    if not source:
+        return None
+
+    try:
+        if source.startswith("data:image/"):
+            header, separator, payload = source.partition(",")
+            if not separator:
+                return None
+            data = unquote_to_bytes(payload)
+            return base64.b64decode(data, validate=True) if header.endswith(";base64") else data
+
+        location = urlsplit(source)
+        key = source
+        if location.scheme or location.netloc:
+            storage_url = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST or "")
+            prefix = storage_url.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+            if (
+                location.scheme not in ("http", "https")
+                or location.scheme != storage_url.scheme
+                or location.netloc.lower() != storage_url.netloc.lower()
+                or not location.path.startswith(prefix)
+            ):
+                return None
+            # Treat a public storage URL as an object key. Only the storage
+            # client chooses the network destination.
+            key = unquote(location.path[len(prefix):])
+
+        if (
+            not key
+            or key.startswith("/")
+            or "\\" in key
+            or any(part in (".", "..") for part in key.split("/"))
+            or any(ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in key)
+        ):
+            return None
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image")
+        return None

+import base64
+import io

+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.sessions.Session, "request", reject_request)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture

+    with io.BytesIO() as buffer:

+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+        "https://other.invalid/image.png",
+        "//other.invalid/image.png",
+        "file:///image.png",
+        "{storage}/%2e%2e/image.png",

+        "{scheme}://{authority}@other.invalid{path}/image.png",
